programme.title: Dickens In Italy With David Harewood
programme.desc: David Harewood investigates the impact Italy had on Charles Dickens, discovering that the quintessentially English author was far more cosmopolitan than expected.

programme.title: Science Fiction In The Atomic Age
programme.desc: Quatermass to Christopher Nolan: Space travel redefines human potential, reviving exploration and conquest while inspiring innovation and unity. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Alec Guinness: A Class Act
programme.desc: Recounted through family, friends and peers, explore the brilliant career of late Oscar winner Alec Guinness - beginning with his 1934 debut at the Playhouse Theatre.

programme.title: New: Portrait Artist Of The Year 2026
programme.desc: New. Nine artists paint food critic Grace Dent or comedians Munya Chawawa and Grace Campbell. Who will claim the final semi-final place? (S13, ep 8)

programme.title: Anish Kapoor: Stupid Naughty Boy
programme.desc: Tasked with the installation of two ambitious shows during the Venice Biennale of 2022, the 70-year-old Anish Kapoor is documented by art critic Waldemar Januszczak.

programme.title: David Lynch: The Directors
programme.desc: Remembering the life of David Lynch, the Academy Award-winning director behind Mulholland Drive, Blue Velvet and The Elephant Man, whose visionary work reshaped cinema. (S5, ep 6)

programme.title: The Eighties
programme.desc: The AIDS Crisis: A look at how the 1980s saw a mysterious and lethal illness known as AIDS develop into a pandemic with enormous political and cultural consequences.

programme.title: Gods Of The Game
programme.desc: Including a trained football fan chorus to mark the World Cup, this operatic tale about the corruption that shrouds the beautiful game at present combines arias and musical pieces.

programme.title: The Joy Of Painting
programme.desc: Evening Waterfall: Bob shares a truly unique piece while painting a flowing river with rapids on black canvas. (S12, ep 8)

programme.title: The Joy Of Painting
programme.desc: Tropical Seascape: Bob demonstrates how to paint an exotic ocean masterpiece, complete with palm trees swaying in the warm breeze. (S12, ep 9)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Hijack: A hijacker on an aeroplane takes a stewardess hostage before demanding a million dollars and a parachute. Will Captain Waterhouse give in to his demands? (S4, ep 17)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Blue Marigold: Dropped by her agency for her diva-like behaviour, supermodel Marigold's mental health deteriorates. Years later, she plots a comeback. (S5, ep 1)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: Six People, No Music: A mortician is torn when a dead man awakens to make his own funeral plans. (S4, ep 13)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: The Morning After: A mother gets involved when she discovers her daughter is seeing a married man. (S4, ep 14)

programme.title: The Alfred Hitchcock Hour
programme.desc: Death of a Cop: A remorseful detective vows to find the men who murdered his son, who followed in his footsteps and also became a cop. (S1, ep 31)

programme.title: Discovering: Michael Keaton
programme.desc: Michael Keaton: From Batman to Spider-Man, Michael Keaton has done it all. This is a glimpse into the Hollywood star's life and career. (S14, ep 5)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: The Eavesdropper: Moira hears a woman discussing a trip to Paris with her lover Donald. Not only is her husband called Donald, but he was in France last week. Coincidence? (S5, ep 2)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Operation Safecrack: In an attempt to prove their safes are impregnable, a company challenges ex-safebreaker Sam to crack one for a cash prize. But are his skills sharp enough? (S5, ep 3)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: A Personal Matter: A killer escapes to an isolated construction site where he suspects a new engineer. (S4, ep 15)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: Out There - Darkness: A rich woman refuses to lend money to the man who walks her dog when he requests a loan. (S4, ep 16)

programme.title: The Eighties
programme.desc: The Reagan Revolution: A look at the personalities and events of Reagan's two terms in the White House - both landmark legislative achievements and political setbacks.

programme.title: Discovering: John Malkovich
programme.desc: John Malkovich: A glimpse into the life of the Academy Award-nominated star whose huge portfolio of work includes starring roles in Places in the Heart and In the Line of Fire. (S14, ep 6)

programme.title: Landscape Artist Of The Year

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Run Rabbit Run: Robert visits a couple who housed him during the war. But in Paris, he discovers that the husband has died, and the hero's wife has a big secret to tell. (S5, ep 4)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Stranger in Town: A stranger arrives in town and soon endears himself to the local community - although his motives prove sinister. (S5, ep 5)

programme.title: Mahler: Inside The Music

programme.title: Run Wild, Run Free
programme.desc: 1969. Drama. Directed by Richard C. Sarafian. Stars John Mills, Sylvia Syms & Gordon Jackson. A psychosomatically mute young boy finds an emotional release through his love for a wild white colt.

programme.title: Road Games
programme.desc: 1981. Thriller. Directed by Richard Franklin. Stars Jamie Lee Curtis, Stacy Keach & Marion Edward. A truck driver in Australia begins to suspect that a man is killing young women along his route.

programme.title: The Big Lift
programme.desc: 1950. War drama starring Montgomery Clift. In 1948 the Soviet Union blockades the allied sectors of Berlin, to bring the entire city under their control.

programme.title: Glimpses - Far Away Places
programme.desc: Parkside Productions present The Malcolm Mitchell Group playing 'Far Away Places'. Directed by Roger Proudlock.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Come Back, Shame. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Cliff Robertson. Batman and Robin reckon something's up when Shame steals Grimaldi Smith's hot racing car in the middle of the Gotham City 500.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: It's How You Play the Game. 1966. Stars Adam West, Cliff Robertson & Eric Shea. Shame goes to work on his final caper - the theft of four prize cattle worth over one million dollars.

programme.title: Johnny On The Spot
programme.desc: 1954. Crime directed by Maclean Rogers. Johnny (Hugh McDermott) returns from a prison sentence to get the man who framed him.

programme.title: Girdle of Gold
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy directed by Montgomery Tully and filmed at Nettlefold. Starring Esmond Knight and Maudie Edwards. A husband hides a fortune in his wife's girdle, only for the girdle to go 'missing'.

programme.title: Hell's Angels
programme.desc: 1930. War. Director: Howard Hughes. Stars Ben Lyon, James Hall & Jean Harlow. Epic war film following the lives of two dissimilar brothers as they join the Royal Flying Corps when war breaks out.

programme.title: Sussex Fortnight
programme.desc: Made in 1950. By bicycle with Raymond Glendenning to Arundel, Littlehampton and a horse show, ending with the Goodwood Cup.

programme.title: Night Train to Paris
programme.desc: 1964. Drama. Director: Robert Douglas. Stars Leslie Nielsen & Aliza Gur. A retired spy agrees to a friend's request to deliver a tape to Paris and prevent it from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: The Instrument of War. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Andrew Keir & Charles Houston. Dan travels to Prisoner's Island to collect valuable cargo, however, the cargo is a single Scottish Highland Chief.

programme.title: The Young Land
programme.desc: 1959. Western. Director: Ted Tetzlaff. Stars Patrick Wayne, Yvonne Craig & Dennis Hopper. American gunslinger kills a Mexican man. He is arrested and the Hispanic population wait for justice.

programme.title: Oliver Twist (1982)
programme.desc: 1982. Drama. Director: Clive Donner. Stars George C. Scott, Tim Curry & Michael Hordern. The classic tale of an orphan boy who finds himself joining a band of thieves after escaping the orphanage.

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1966. Infamous Conduct. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & Dermot Walsh. A famous surgeon loses his license (and his wife) after a female patient accuses him of conduct unbecoming a physician. (S1, E12)

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Ted & Mrs Fox P1. Stars Russell Hunter, Madeline Smith and Maureen Pryor. In a world where nobody has the time to 'listen', people like Ted and Mrs Fox are lucky to find each other.

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Ted & Mrs Fox P2. Stars Joyce Heron, Russell Hunter, Perry Balfour, Madeline Smith & Maureen Pryor. Mrs Fox and Ted are incurable romantics, clinging to memories of the past.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Fly Casting/The Log Splitter. 1986. Jack Hargreaves illustrates the technical advances in fly fishing. He then shows us his latest gadget for chopping logs for his wood burning stove.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: The Turncoat. 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, David Daker & Forbes Collins. Spiker is ambushed whilst carrying a letter for Sir John Glutton, who then forces Dick Turpin to recover the message.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Enemy. Stars Barry Foster, Joanna Dunham & Nigel Stock. When Van der Valk and his wife Arlette receive death threats, the detective finds himself looking for a mysterious Enemy.

programme.title: An Innocent Man
programme.desc: 1989. Crime Drama. Directed by Peter Yates. Stars Tom Selleck, F. Murray Abraham & Laila Robins. Two corrupt cops send an innocent man to prison, leading him to seek revenge on his release.

programme.title: The Devil's Hand
programme.desc: 1961. Horror. Directed by William J. Hole Jr. Stars Linda Christian, Robert Alda & Ariadne Welter. A man, haunted by visions of a beautiful woman, winds up in a Satanic cult after meeting her.

programme.title: The Mark of Cain
programme.desc: 1947. Crime Drama. Directed by Brian Desmond Hurst. Stars Eric Portman, Sally Gray & Patrick Holt. A young French girl instigates rivalry between two brothers when she marries the younger one.

programme.title: Action Stations
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Directed by Cecil H. Williamson and starring Paul Carpenter and Mary Martin. A forger flees to Spain but his daughter is kidnapped by a gang.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Join the amazing Vince Taylor as he performs the entrancing hit Twenty Flight Rock.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: The Marker. Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Penguin's Nest. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burgess Meredith & Vito Scotti. The Penguin tries to get arrested as he wants to be sent back to prison so he can team up with a forger residing there.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Bird's Last Jest. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burgess Meredith & Alan Napier. Batman requests Alfred to go undercover, in an attempt to spring a trap on the Penguin and stop his latest scheme.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Sam Peckinpah, a hard-hitting director who had seen atrocities at the end of the war as a marine became known for his violent scenes, he is remembered as the man who reinvented the western.

programme.title: Demobbed
programme.desc: 1944. Comedy. Demobbed from the army, four troublesome soldiers are reunited with their old Sergeant. Starring Norman Evans, Nat Jackley and Dan Young. Directed by John E Blakely.

programme.title: The Widow From Chicago
programme.desc: 1930. Crime Drama. Directed by Edward F. Cline. Stars Alice White, Edward G. Robinson & Neil Hamilton. A woman infiltrates the mob in order to avenge her brother's death.

programme.title: The Breaking Point
programme.desc: 1961. The nephew of a printer gets involved with foreign spies' intent on making counterfeit money. Stars Peter Reynolds & Dermot Walsh.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: Public Lives - Part 1. 1973. Stars Jim Norton, Jill Freud, Joseph Berry. A theatre director and a theatre producer face obscenity charges relating to a play they presented entitled 'Public Lives'.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: Public Lives - Part 2. 1973. Stars Kevin Stoney, Brian Wilde & Jennifer Clulow. Actress Mandy Jenkins speaks about how she was sacked from the play and author E.W. Appleby makes a statement.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: Public Lives - Part 3. 1973. Stars Jim Norton & Christopher Burgess. Jeremy Williams continues giving evidence and denies making an obscene production, and Anthony Standing MP provides his views.

programme.title: Pete Murray Takes You To Hastings 1981
programme.desc: Pete Murray takes you along his travels through the picturesque and historical coastal town of Hastings.

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street

In just 24 hours, on a limited budget, they create clever storage solutions in the utility and bathroom, and a cat wall to keep her fur-babies busy. Narrated by Sion Daniel Young

programme.title: Going to the Dogs
programme.desc: The story of Wimbledon Greyhound Stadium, which drew crowds of 25,000 in its heyday. After it closed in 2017 just two of London's once-27 greyhound race tracks remain operating

programme.title: The Wild Gardener
programme.desc: After 30 years of filming the creatures of the world, wildlife cameraman Colin Stafford-Johnson returns home on a personal project - to turn his old childhood garden into a haven for native wildlife. He begins by getting down and dirty, digging ponds, clearing scrub, planting woodland and sowing meadows as he tries to figure out how best to lure the wild creatures back

programme.title: Our Dream Farm with Matt Baker
programme.desc: Matt Baker helps the National Trust find a new tenant for the vacant Wallington Estate farm in Northumberland and its 340 acres of grassland, woodland and wetland. Matt follows the process as seven applicants for the 10-year lease spend three weeks demonstrating they have what it takes to be chosen for the position. In this first episode, Matt arrives at the estate to meet the seven applicants. It's lambing season, so the hopefuls get straight to work

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: As the makeover show returns, Alan Titchmarsh and the team head to Fareham near Southampton to surprise Betty Richards, a life-long volunteer. The 90 year old suffers from macular degeneration, and her garden is a green-free concrete box - with so many levels and trip hazards that it's off limits to the sight-impaired dare-devil fundraiser, so the team sets about transforming it into a safe haven

programme.title: Build a New Life in the Country
programme.desc: 4/9. Keith and Antoinette are converting an 1800's chateau-style house into a family home and B & B. With a tight budget, Antoinette must juggle the build and her four kids solo.

programme.title: Sort Your Life Out with Stacey Solomon
programme.desc: Stacey and her team help the Harris-Hawley family transform their home. Childhood sweethearts Dan and Char along with their daughters Mia and Cece realise just how much unnecessary clutter they own when they take everything out and see it displayed in front of them. The family go through their most treasured items full of emotion, reflecting on the tough times they've come through ahead of their wedding which is just one week away

programme.title: That Riviera Touch
programme.desc: Comedy starring Eric Morecambe and Ernie Wise. Eric and Ernie decide to leave it all behind for a holiday in the south of France. Arriving at a deserted villa, they soon become involved with a gang of jewel thieves and a beautiful woman.

programme.title: Melvin - Son of Alvin
programme.desc: Melvin is the shy son of legendary Alvin Purple. He works as a teenage car-wash attendant and is unknowingly irresistible to women due to his father's legacy. Comedy starring Tina Bursill, Gerry Sont, Graeme Blundell.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Regeneration
programme.desc: A dead soldier who was brought back to life as the ultimate killing machine is revived once more to deal with terrorists who have taken control of a nuclear reactor. He finds his enemies not only have a more advanced reanimated soldier in their ranks, but they have also resurrected an old foe of his. Sci-fi thriller sequel, starring Jean-Claude Van Damme and Dolph Lundgren

programme.title: Tower of Evil
programme.desc: Archaeologists are searching for the tomb of an ancient chieftain on a remote and spooky island when a merciless maniac strikes, attacking their party over and over again. Horror, starring Jill Haworth, Bryant Halliday, Jack Watson and Anna Palk

programme.title: Women and Men: Stories of Seduction
programme.desc: Three short stories, each focused on a man and a woman. In 'The Man in a Brooks Brothers Suit,' a businessman pursues a woman aboard a train. In 'Dusk Before Fireworks,' a flapper's romantic evening is interrupted by constant phone calls. In 'Hills Like White Elephants,' a couple discusses the woman's pregnancy while traveling in Spain.

programme.title: Second Chorus
programme.desc: When perennial college students Danny O'Neill (Fred Astaire) & Hank Taylor (Burgess Meredith) are forced to make it on their own, the pair get jobs with Artie Shaw's band and reunite with ex-manager Ellen Miller (Paulette Goddard). Remastered for 4K UHD

programme.title: A Family for the Holidays
programme.desc: Seasonal romance starring Erin Krakow. Affairs of the heart and an old family secret threaten to scupper the plans of a woman flying to her home town at Christmas.

programme.title: Finding Father Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Erin Krakow. Christmas has always been painful for Miranda who has no family to spend it with. But when the opportunity to find her father arises, it brings a couple of surprises, including the possibility of new love.

programme.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
programme.desc: All-star film version of Lewis Carroll's classic children's fantasy featuring Peter Sellers, Spike Milligan and Michael Crawford, with Fiona Fullerton as Alice.

programme.title: Dreamchild
programme.desc: Fantasy drama starring Coral Browne and Ian Holm. April 1932: attending the Lewis Carroll Centenary in New York, 80-year-old Alice Hargreaves - the inspiration for "Alice in Wonderland" - becomes increasingly haunted by her childhood memories of the strange and repressed Reverend Charles Dodgson.

programme.title: A Gift for Christmas
programme.desc: Seasonal romance starring Ali Liebert and Peter Porte. A woman who hits a man with her bike, causing him to lose his memory, is determined to find out more about this handsome stranger.

programme.title: For the Love of Chocolate
programme.desc: A member of a chocolate-making duo is preparing for a high profile contest, when her partner in the kitchen abruptly pulls out. She soon finds a new creative partner in a chance meeting with a single father, and while working on their sweet creations, they each find the missing ingredient in their lives. Romantic comedy, with Rhiannon Fish and Jesse Hutch

programme.title: Somewhere Tomorrow
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Sarah Jessica Parker. A fatherless teenage girl is befriended by the ghost of a young man who died in an aircrash. She finds herself falling in love with the ghost, and has to choose between staying with him in his ghost world, or returning to what remains of her family on Earth.

programme.title: BMX Bandits
programme.desc: Adventure starring Nicole Kidman. Three teenage BMX bikers discover a stash of stolen two-way radios. Unaware that the radios belong to bank robbers, they begin selling them to their friends. This creates havoc with local police radio frequencies and sends the robbers in pursuit of the bike-riding youngsters.

programme.title: The Man with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: Drama starring Frank Sinatra and Kim Novak. Chicago: card dealer and heroin addict Frankie Machine has just got out of jail. He returns to his old haunts determined to kick his habits and become a musician. But the pressures of dealing with a wife in a wheelchair, a pusher and the woman he really loves make things tough.

programme.title: The Holcroft Covenant
programme.desc: Spy thriller starring Michael Caine and Anthony Andrews. New York architect Noel Holcroft has had to live with the knowledge that his natural father, now dead, was a leading Nazi. One day he is summoned to Geneva and given a letter written by his father 40 years earlier. The contents of the letter, referring to his father's covenant, are to change his life.

programme.title: The Negotiator
programme.desc: Action drama starring Samuel L Jackson and Kevin Spacey. Police hostage negotiator Danny Roman is informed by his partner that some of their colleagues are embezzling funds. When his partner is murdered, suspicion falls on Roman and he realises that he must take drastic action to clear his name.

programme.title: Romance Retreat
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Amanda Schull and Morgan David Jones. A journalist faces a dilemma when she finds herself on a yoga retreat with a handsome guy who happens to be involved in a scandal she's investigating.

programme.title: Girlfriends of Christmas Past
programme.desc: Three women who share the same unfaithful ex-boyfriend conspire to get revenge on him during a Christmas gathering. However, one of them falls in love with the event planner organising the party, and is torn between her feelings for him and her loyalty to her friends. Romantic comedy, starring Tammin Sursok and Carter Bolton

programme.title: Love Always, Santa
programme.desc: Seasonal romance starring Marguerite Moreau and Mike Faiola. Widow Celia has dedicated her whole life to young daughter Lilly. But Lilly doesn't want her mother to spend another Christmas alone and so writes a letter to Santa asking for Celia to be happy again.

programme.title: The People That Time Forgot
programme.desc: An explorer braves encounters with dinosaurs as he leads an expedition to the mysterious island prehistoric island to rescue his marooned naval officer friend from a forgotten civilisation. Fantasy adventure sequel to The Land that Time Forgot, starring Patrick Wayne, Doug McClure and Sarah Douglas

programme.title: The Gold Rush
programme.desc: A prospector seeks shelter in a cabin during a fierce snowstorm and gets involved in an altercation with the two men already huddled inside. Silent comedy, starring Charlie Chaplin, with Tom Murray and Mack Swain

programme.title: Love Strikes Twice
programme.desc: An unhappily married woman takes a fresh look at love after she has an accident on the way to see a divorce lawyer and wakes up with amnesia. Romantic drama, starring Katrina Begin and Tilky Jones

programme.title: Forever in My Heart
programme.desc: While in Ireland on an internship, Jenna falls in love with the Charlie, the son of the owner of the hotel she has been assigned to, but they end up going their separate ways. Five years later, she returns to Ireland and bumps into Charlie again - and it's immediately clear that they still have feelings for one another. Romantic drama, starring Merritt Patterson and Jack Turner

programme.title: The Assassination Bureau
programme.desc: Period black comedy starring Oliver Reed and Diana Rigg. Europe, 1906: the Assassination Bureau is a secret society that only kills people who really deserve it. A mysterious, beautiful woman decides to put out a contract - for the head of the bureau himself.

programme.title: Behind the Wall
programme.desc: The horrible truth about the past is slowly unveiled about the murder of Katelyn’s mother when her body is discovered in an abandoned lighthouse undergoing redevelopment. Contains some violent content.

programme.title: The Client
programme.desc: Thriller based on the novel by John Grisham, starring Susan Sarandon, Tommy Lee Jones and Brad Renfro. Young Mark Sway attracts the attention of both the law and the Mafia when he inadvertently witnesses the suicide of a Mob defence lawyer. The lawyer has passed on to Mark the location of a murdered senator, information that makes the boy and his family a target for sinister forces. Realising he needs protection, Mark enlists the help of attorney Reggie Love.

programme.title: Casablanca Express
programme.desc: A British commando is appointed as Winston Churchill's personal bodyguard, but soon has his work cut out for him when Nazi soldiers hijack a train transporting the prime minister to a vital strategic conference. Second World War thriller, starring Jason Connery and Donald Pleasence

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring Christian Bale, Steve Carell, Ryan Gosling and Brad Pitt. United States, 2006: eccentric Wall Street whizzkid Michael Burry realises that the US mortgage market is heading towards a crash and begins to bet against it. This activity attracts the attention of trader Jared Vennett and idealistic hedge-fund expert Mark Baum who begin to suspect that the system could be about to collapse.

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Classic drama starring Janet Gaynor and Fredric March. Declining Hollywood movie star Norman Maine meets young waitress Esther Blodgett at a party and promises to make her a star. But as her career goes from strength to strength, Maine's continues to go downhill.

programme.title: Married by Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring April Bowlby and Jes Macallan. When two sisters discover that their father's company will be inherited by whichever one marries first, the sister who has worked to build the business begins a frantic search for a husband.

programme.title: A Perfect Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic fantasy starring Claire Coffee and Ryan McPartlin. Young executive Holly Maddux wakes after a fall to find that the hunky mannequin she admired in a department store window has come to life and is by her side. Love blossoms, but Holly soon discovers that being perfect all the time is hard work.

programme.title: Modern Times
programme.desc: Comedy starring Charlie Chaplin. A factory worker becomes so unhinged by his menial job that he winds up in hospital. Following his release and a spell in jail, he befriends a young orphan woman and falls in love.

programme.title: Cup of Love
programme.desc: A food scientist is sent to Colombia, where she meets a local plantation owner who is reluctant to work with her at first, but slowly romance blossoms. Romantic drama, starring Anna Hutchison, Nikolás Rincón and David Ojalvo

programme.title: A Puppy for Christmas
programme.desc: A woman loses her job, her flat and her boyfriend just before Christmas - all thanks to her mischievous pet dog. A co-worker invites her to come and spend the holiday with him on his farm, and the experience leaves her torn between pursuing a new life in the country or trying to rebuild her old city life. Festive romantic comedy, starring Cindy Busby, Greyston Holt and Christopher Russell

programme.title: Candid about Love
programme.desc: Laura, a gallery assistant and wannabe fine art photographer, is finally promised a spot in a Newcomer’s Showcase - but only if she can get a reclusive artist, Shane, to premiere his newest photographs at the gallery. When Laura discovers that Shane hasn’t taken a new photo in ten years, she’s determined to help him find his way back to his art whether he wants her to or not.

programme.title: The Boy in the Plastic Bubble
programme.desc: Offbeat drama about a youngster forced to live in a sterile isolation unit because he was born with no natural immunity to disease. Starring John Travolta, Robert Reed and Buzz Aldrin

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Classic drama starring Janet Gaynor and Fredric March. Declining Hollywood movie star Norman Maine meets young waitress Esther Blodgett at a party and promises to make her a star. But as her career goes from strength to strength, Maine's continues to go downhill.

programme.title: Giant Killer Ants
programme.desc: From FrightFest Presents. Tremors meets Spinal Tap in this excell-ant monster movie with bite. Starring Sean Astin (Stranger Things) and Tom Arnold. A 1989 'one-hit-wonder' glam-metal band embark on a trip to the No-chella rock festival in the hopes for a comeback. But a carefree psychedelic pit stop results in them facing an army of flesh-eating ants that keep increasing in size! A must see!

programme.title: Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Martial arts drama starring Bruce Lee. Karate pupil Chen Chen returns to Shanghai for the funeral of his former teacher. When he discovers that his mentor was in fact murdered, Chen sets out to avenge his death.

programme.title: Five Corners
programme.desc: Thriller starring Jodie Foster and Tim Robbins. A young woman alienates her disabled boyfriend by seeking protection when an ex-convict who tried to rape her returns to the area. After a teacher's murder, for which the former prisoner is a suspect, the woman places herself in danger by agreeing to meet her attacker again.

programme.title: Cheer for Your Life
programme.desc: A high school girl's spirits are crushed as she suffers through a humiliating 'Initiation', but her dreams aren't the only thing in danger when another girl on the squad turns up dead, and when she disappears herself, her mom will have to rush to save her

programme.desc: Monster adventure starring Bill Travers and William Sylvester. A prehistoric monster is captured off the coast of Ireland and brought to London where it is exhibited in a circus. But having determined that the monster is an infant, scientists suspect that one of its parents may also still be alive.

programme.title: My Dad Is Scrooge
programme.desc: A boy is shocked when his grouchy father gives a farmer a foreclosure notice just before Christmas. He wakes up one night to discover the farmyard animals in his room, who reveal they can talk and offer to help him play a trick that will teach his dad the importance of Christmas spirit. Festive fantasy, starring Brian Cook and Christian Laurian Kerr

programme.title: Journey to the Christmas Star
programme.desc: A teenage girl living in a kingdom that has been cursed ventures into a sinister dark forest in search of a lost magical star - the only thing that can break the enchantment and return the king's missing daughter. However, an evil witch intends to stop her and seize the throne herself. Fantasy adventure, starring Vilde Marie Zeiner and Anders Baasmo Christiansen. In Norwegian

programme.title: Maya the Bee: The Honey Games
programme.desc: An overenthusiastic bee accidentally embarrasses an empress, and is forced to take part in a contest to save her hive. Animated adventure, with the voices of Coco Jack Gillies, Benson Jack Anthony and Richard Roxburgh

programme.title: Perfect Wedding
programme.desc: When two event planners are forced to work together to organise a wedding for an engaged couple that cannot agree, they learn that opposites can produce the most unexpected results. Comedy, starring Danica McKellar, Paul Greene and Linda Gray

But young Kevin still believes, and together with his teacher and some new friends sets out to show just how magical the festive season can be.

programme.title: A Handful of Dust
programme.desc: Period drama starring James Wilby and Kristen Scott Thomas. Brenda Last has everything that other women would envy - a loving and aristocratic husband, an adorable son and a huge stately home in the country. But for an amusing diversion, Brenda starts an affair with a social-climbing scrounger from London. It is the start of an inexorable slide to disaster.

programme.title: Keep the Aspidistra Flying
programme.desc: Period romantic comedy based on the satirical novel by George Orwell, starring Richard E Grant and Helena Bonham Carter. When a successful copywriter abandons his career to become a poet, it's up to his long-suffering girlfriend to keep their relationship on the rails.

programme.desc: Evil wizard Lord Tensley (James Marsters) despatches everyone in his realm who has fallen in love... by sending down a fire-breathing dragon. He promises to call off the creature if his true love - Princess Ennogard (Kaitlin Doubleday) - succumbs to his fiery blandishments. However, she puts out an SOS call to an unlikely group of heroes, led by the laid-back hero Ramicus (Adam Johnson) and his estranged brother Camilan (Maclain Nelson). But will they be too late?

programme.title: Hijacked

programme.title: A Cinderella Christmas
programme.desc: Romance starring Emma Rigby and Peter Porte. Put-upon party planner Angie meets handsome bachelor Nikolaus at a masked ball. But after she leaves without telling him who she is, Nikolaus is determined to track her down.

But when Joe, a stubborn, difficult, but influential website editor, hires her to organize his niece's 10th birthday party, Kelly quickly realizes that she may have just met her match.

programme.title: A Song for Christmas
programme.desc: Seasonal romance starring Kelli Williams and Jonathan Scarfe. Two single parents start to fall in love only to learn that their daughters are arch rivals at school.

programme.title: David Copperfield
programme.desc: Classic period drama based on the novel by Charles Dickens, starring WC Fields, Lionel Barrymore and Freddie Bartholomew. David Copperfield's idyllic life with his adoring mother changes radically when she falls under the influence of the tyrannical Mr Murdstone.

programme.title: Lassie Come Home
programme.desc: Florian and his beloved Collie Lassie are inseparable and live happily in an idyllic village. When Florian's father loses his job, the family move to a flat and Lassie's placed in the hands of Count von Sprengel, although when his mean caretaker starts treating Lassie badly, she escapes and searches for Flo, not knowing Flo also can't stand it any longer and is looking for his dog. Adventure, starring Nico Marischka

Comedy, starring Anthony Hopkins, Ben Mendelsohn, Alwyn Kurts and Bruno Lawrence

When he blows out the candles on his birthday cake, his wish for some answers to life's many questions is surprisingly granted in the shape of a mystical leprechaun (Gary Oldman) who guides him on a surreal journey of self discovery. Bob Gale's fantasy comedy, featuring a star-studded list of cameos including Michael J Fox, Kurt Russell, Liv Tyler and Christopher Lloyd

Julia Jones's parents would like her to settle down with a nice boy who shares her Greek-African-American-Indian-Japanese heritage. But Julia has her sights set on wet-but-handsome Englishman Grant Funkyerdoder, who has no idea what he's letting himself in for.

programme.desc: A young French soldier cut off from his unit in Napoleon's army is beguiled by a mysterious woman, whom he learns is the wife of an elderly Baron - and that she seemingly died twenty years earlier. Horror, starring Boris Karloff and Jack Nicholson

programme.desc: Musical comedy chronicling the adventures of a brother-and-sister dance team performing in London at the time of the then Princess Elizabeth's wedding. Starring Fred Astaire, Jane Powell, Peter Lawford and Keenan Wynn

programme.desc: Comedy adventure starring David Niven and Toshiro Mifune. "Major" Bradbury is a naturally timid man who has invented a heroic past for himself - the last thing he expected was to become involved with ruthless terrorists and experience a dangerous situation first hand.

Drama, starring Will Poulter and Alma Jodorowsky

Comedy drama, starring Jeremy Allen White and Maika Monroe

Alfred Hitchcock's period adventure based on the Daphne du Maurier novel, starring Charles Laughton, Maureen O'Hara and Leslie Banks

But later, when she faces financial difficulties and falls seriously ill, she discovers that Armand still loves her
